analysis.title: GS - Stankard - Vol Views - 28 Oct 2026
key_insights: Desk sees AI concerns, Middle East tensions and midterm elections as sources of near-term volatility, while earnings support and lighter positioning (GS PB nets at 5-year lows) could help equities into year-end.
Flows have turned more constructive, with call volumes about 57% of the tape this week, above the year-to-date average.
Preferred structure: rent upside with limited-loss structures and pair it with SPX lookback puts as the hedge.
Megacap Tech earnings and FOMC are the main focus for the rest of the week. Implied move through Friday is 1.1%. About two-thirds of SPX market cap will have reported by Friday.

Earnings setups: MSFT is up 50% from summer lows with an 8/10 GS positioning score and a 4.7% implied move vs a 15.5% move last quarter. LLY is up 10.7% MTD with a 9/10 score and a 6% implied move. MA is up 10.5% MTD with a 9/10 score and a 2.7% implied move.
Cash and vol desks see investors picking spots across AI. Mag 7 implied vol is cheap relative to the broader tech complex, with the ratio at the 15th percentile vs the last 4 years.
The GS neocloud basket (GSXUNEOC) is down over 28% MTD even after a 7% rally yesterday. The desk sees convertible bonds as an interesting way to play further reversion.
The NDX vs SPX implied vol spread blew out last week and then compressed. The 1m ATM spread is still at the 94th percentile vs 4 years, but the 3-day compression was the largest in that window.
Korea: the GS PB book has seen heavy net selling MTD with net and gross allocations falling sharply. A renewed AI trade could spark a chase in Korea.
Light exotic structures (lookback puts, knock-out calls) are offered as cheaper ways to hedge or add upside. Knock-out calls on AI names are priced at 65-81% discounts to vanilla calls.

Clients are showing more interest in dispersion trades (short index vol, long single-stock vol). Rising NDX implied correlation has pushed the single-stock-to-index vol ratio lower, which the desk calls an attractive entry point.

trade_ideas.description: Buy SPX 31Mar27 90% lookback put with daily lookback until Dec 31, cost 1.82%
trade_ideas.rationale: Removes the need to time the top for about 10bp over the 5-year average price of a vanilla put. Allows for a possible Santa rally.

trade_ideas.description: Buy 3m 105%/130% continuous knock-out calls on AMAT, AMD, AVGO, KLAC, MU
trade_ideas.rationale: Capital-efficient way to play an expected 10-25% cyclical bounce, with 1-for-1 participation above the 105% strike unless the 130% intraday barrier is touched.
trade_ideas.risk: Payoff is lost if the stock touches the 130% knock-out barrier during regular hours.

trade_ideas.rationale: Rising NDX implied correlation has pushed the single-stock-to-index vol ratio lower, creating an attractive entry.
